goal: Repair the local release regressions exposed after batch-execution-recovery: recovery decoration must respect the initial authority read retry limit and preserve actionable scope errors, while Pi QA failure assertions cover the structured recovery contract.

acceptance.assertion: Recovery decoration cannot re-read failed or semantically invalid initial authority projections, create a misleading recovered projection, replay QA or mutate authority. Explicit EINTR/EAGAIN initial reads remain bounded to one retry; EACCES and semantic conflicts stop after one read. Pi preserves the existing legal path reconciliation action when a delivery envelope is invalid rather than overriding it with a generic authority inspection. Typed QA preparation failures return fresh, exact task/acceptance recovery identities with a non-attesting environment repair action and no raw verifier output. Existing foreground, finding and Review preparation behavior remains covered by the focused regression tests.
